title: Response formatting
description: Shared writing defaults for Chat and Philharmonic.
introduction: Chat, the Philharmonic PM and model-based employees receive the same writing defaults. Coding-agent employees receive them as task guidance because each CLI owns its system prompt. These defaults govern human-facing replies; explicit user formats and required JSON, tool protocols and deliverable formats take precedence. They guide new generations and do not rewrite saved messages.

entries.title: Shared response format
entries.name: RESPONSE_FORMAT_PROMPT
entries.description: Headings, paragraphs, lists, tables, emphasis, code and Markdown structure.

title: Chat
description: Chat identity, tools, personalization, interactive blocks and conversation titles.
introduction: The main prompt inserts the shared [response formatting](/docs/prompts/writing) and interactive-block sections below. It also adds the current date and conditional MCP, workspace and skills directories. Personalization is appended separately. User-written custom prompts are not built-in prompts and are not reproduced here.

title: Philharmonic
description: PM coordination, employee reports, recruitment and group context.
introduction: The PM and employees append the current workspace, group brief and permitted tools/skills at runtime. The builders below document those boundaries without publishing anyone’s workspace, messages or employee configuration. System-role interruption/error notices in the transcript are status messages, not model instructions.
